guidelines: A junior Digital / Growth Marketer working on products for Nigerian and African users. Good work is audience-specific, benefit-led, honest (no unverifiable claims) and measurable.

criteria.name: Value proposition
criteria.description: Headline and subhead make the specific benefit clear to the target user in seconds.

criteria.name: Audience fit
criteria.description: Speaks to the stated audience's needs, language and objections.

criteria.name: Page structure
criteria.description: Logical sections: benefits, proof, how it works, FAQ, clear CTA.

criteria.name: Honesty and compliance
criteria.description: No invented stats, guarantees or misleading claims.

criteria.name: Target segment
criteria.description: A specific, reachable initial segment with rationale.

criteria.name: Channels and tactics
criteria.description: Realistic channels for the segment and budget, sequenced.

criteria.name: Metrics and budget
criteria.description: Funnel metrics, targets and a rough budget.

criteria.name: Risks
criteria.description: Main risks and how to test assumptions cheaply.

criteria.name: Delivers the task
criteria.description: Requested copy, plan or analysis delivered.

criteria.name: Audience and positioning
criteria.description: Specific and consistent with the product.
